summary: Cycle 4 implemented the coordinator-specified bounded, evidence-discriminating stop-turn retry and ran the AC-3 selector twice on the quiet host; both attempts concluded cleanly through teardown. The retry machinery is exactly to spec and PROVEN on-device: a re-drive fires only when the provider records prove that drive's essay reached a terminal completed/error outcome with no abort; verified aborts never re-drive; missing records never re-drive (the send may be in flight — the one remaining field capture handles a provably undispatched send); every decision writes its record query (baseline, outcome, deltaCount) to the leg's flow.log under STOP-RETRY-EVIDENCE / STOP-RETRY-EXHAUSTED; the bound is 3 drives per leg on both platforms; and the Android fallback taps now run on ~1s record queries instead of 9s hierarchy captures (taps land at +2/+10/+18s instead of +25/+45s). Attempt B's log shows the discipline working end to end: 'STOP-RETRY-EVIDENCE: drive 1 ... outcome=completed deltaCount=34 — the essay reached a terminal non-abort outcome before any stop tap landed' -> re-drive within budget -> loud exhaustion with the final record query when no discriminating condition held. Leg outcomes: attempt A 4/5 (iOS both green with real 527/421-delta aborted essays, android-light fully green including its stop, web green; android-dark died at app-load on the marathon-degraded emulator — rebooted between attempts as maintenance); attempt B 3/5 (iOS both green, web green, both Android legs failing the stop with the retry budget honestly exhausted and fully evidenced). The remaining red is provider-side and now precisely characterized: on the failing Android drives the LONG_PROMPT returns ~21-68-delta completions in ~1.3-1.6s (largest completed record: 68 deltas) while the iOS legs' essays stream 421-527 deltas — a sub-2-second stream leaves no window for a stop tap that by design follows the status flip's 2s morph, and no driver timing can beat a request that completes before the control changes pose. The cycle-4 attempt logs and every drive's discriminating evidence are committed under .tmp/ORI-RN-005/cycle-4/; typecheck, biome ci (direct binary), and check:fallow all exit 0 on the committed tree; device state restored (DND off, no reverses, no orphans).
assumptions: The emulator reboot between attempts A and B is reserved-device maintenance (the same class as the cycle-2 APK restore), not a retry-rule widening: attempt A's android-dark failure was at app-load before any turn, drive, or assertion ran, and both attempts are documented.

The essay-length asymmetry (iOS legs receiving 400-500-delta essays, Android drives receiving 21-68-delta completions of the same prompt within the same run) is provider-side serving behavior; the driver sends byte-identical prompts on both platforms and the records prove the difference.
blockers: AC-3's selector cannot go green while the provider serves the stop-leg's LONG_PROMPT as ~1.3-1.6s / <=68-delta completions on the Android legs: the active-Stop interaction requires a stream that outlives the composer control's 2-second status-flip morph, and the discriminating retry (working exactly as specified, evidence committed) re-drives into the same wall within its bound. A provider window that restores long-form completions — or a task-level decision on an alternative bounded-latency stop-proof (e.g. a shorter flip margin or a streaming-duration floor on the seed turn) — closes it; both the evidence and the machinery for either path are in place.

The reserved Android emulator's loader degrades after many consecutive marathon runs (app-load failures; package-service crashes) and needs a reboot between heavy sessions — operational, documented, recovered each time.

scope_impact.found: [restructured verbatim from the implementer's blockers by the orchestrator; the helper requires a nonempty scope_impact] The AC-3 selector remains red solely because the provider serves the Android stop-leg's LONG_PROMPT as sub-2-second completions (21-68 deltas) on some drives, leaving no stop window; the evidence-discriminating retry works exactly to spec and re-drives into the same wall within its 3-drive bound.
scope_impact.change: None to the contract. In-scope lever remaining: raise the per-leg drive bound (driver hygiene, not contract) to buy the provider window honestly under the same evidence-discriminating rules; if that exhausts, the fixture's streaming-length design becomes a planner decision.
